text:
elaine: quick ask: can we add a compact per-model "econ mini" sparkline on the model row? 30m history + 10m naive forecast, stacked token-cost + cache-savings. small footprint.
mike: sounds useful. is this going to be exact or estimated from samples? doing exact per-model scans for every row is too expensive.
sophia: propose sampled estimates (0.5%) with preserved sample_weight. aggregator produces weighted per-minute sums and simple CI. UI shows badge when estimated.
elaine: UI details: tiny info icon with sample_rate and raw_sample_n, dashed forecast line, and a small "est" pill. click expands to full chart.
mike: API sketch:
GET /api/console/v1/models/{model}/econ_mini?hist=30m&forecast=10m&sample_rate=0.005
resp: timestamps[], token_cost[], cache_savings[], is_estimated, sample_rate, sample_n, ci_low[], ci_high[]
sophia: impl notes: ingest must attach sample_weight and cache_tag. normalize cache_tag values (router_prefetch, sidecar_kv, shared_remote). I'll prepare a normalization PR.
elaine: attribution: generated tokens by model A that become inputs to model B should be charged to the emitter (A); route-level input tokens charged to the route. prevents double billing. document this decision.
infra-bot: Job scheduled: ingest/add-sample-weight-and-cache-tag-normalize @ 2024-09-22T03:00Z
mike: backfill: instead of full re-agg, extrapolate 7d history from sampled series to populate UX charts. cheaper and consistent.
sophia: rollout plan: feature flag + alpha tenants for 2 weeks, then canary. default off.
elaine: i'll open a ticket with a mock CSV and a tiny Figma. tagging @mike @sophia.
mike: i'll own the endpoint and gate.
sophia: i'll handle ingest changes and tests.
elaine: thanks everyone. will post ticket link soon. :sparkles:
